editorial.blurb: Batter & Berries is a warm, family-friendly brunch destination where standout dishes like the Catfish Executive and French Toast Flight pair perfectly with genuinely kind service.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the French Toast Flight to sample multiple flavors (reviewers rave about the caramel and peach options), and ask your server for recommendations—the staff here loves engaging with guests.

topDishes.note: Consistently called the standout, easily the best thing reviewers had
Multiple flavors (caramel, peach, bourbon, strawberry) all praised; a must-try
Described as the best omelette one reviewer has ever had
